Concerns.Title: Unrecorded
Concerns.Pitch: Intake, nine days ago, from the Wellmeet road. Subject: a woman, travelling alone, one lamp, unlit. Condition: good. Salt-cure begun. Last words: not witnessed. Index position: unrecorded, which is a shelf with very many people on it. Grief noted. She lodged at the inn at Wellmeet before the road. Guests there chalk a line on the slate when they leave, and the innkeeper sat with her the last evening. My intake card wants a witness's mark before it is valid.
Concerns.Thanks: Index line entered. Her lamp came in with her intake, unlit; it is shelved beside her, as is correct for personal effects. She can be found now.

Approaches.Label: Read what she chalked on the slate at Wellmeet's inn.
Approaches.Objective: Read the lodging slate at Wellmeet's inn

Approaches.Label: Take the intake card to Wellmeet's innkeeper, who sat with her.
Approaches.Objective: Take the intake card to the innkeeper at Wellmeet

Carry.Handover: From the Salt-Vault. The indexer asks what she said, the woman who went out on the Vault road.
Carry.Reply: Her. She asked whether the road was long. I said not very. She said, 'Then I'll not need the lamp,' and I gave it her anyway. Put that in their file, if it goes in a file. And put that she drank first.

Refusal.Text: I will not go asking after her.
Refusal.Reply: Declined. Noted. She is filed under unrecorded. That is not your fault, and the file says so.
